content: Build Action Manifest Overview The BuildActionManifest is an ARElement providing the ability to describe particular steps to be performed in a given environment which need to be performed e.g. when an AUTOSAR executable. It mainly consists of the two entities: • BuildAction is one particular action to be performed in order to contribute to the generation of e.g. the ECU executable. • BuildActionEnvironment provides information about the environment, which is used to perform the BuildActions.
